name: James
about: Source of the Wisdom Books Explorer's James (/tools/wisdom-books). Each verse is tagged by hand with one or more themes fitted to this letter; 'heading' marks the greeting. Verse text is never typed here: scripts/build-wisdom-books-index.mjs fills it from the BSB. noteTheme names a theme in the Study Bible's introduction to James (client/public/bible/notes/james/intro.json), shown word for word. The teaching panel is the introduction's counsel on reading the letter, the hard question on James 2 (faith and deeds with Paul), and the hard question on Romans 4 (the same question from Paul's side), word for word.

themes.name: Trials and endurance
themes.line: Joy in trials of many kinds, the testing that grows perseverance, and the prophets and Job as examples of patience.

themes.name: Wisdom from above
themes.line: Asking God for wisdom without doubting, and the wisdom from above set against jealousy and selfish ambition.

themes.name: Faith and deeds
themes.line: Doers of the word and not hearers only, faith that is dead without deeds, and Abraham and Rahab.

themes.name: The poor and the rich
themes.line: The lowly lifted and the rich brought low, favoritism in the assembly, wages withheld, and riches that rot.

themes.name: The tongue
themes.line: Quick to listen and slow to speak, the small fire of the tongue, slander and complaining, and a plain yes or no.

themes.name: The royal law and mercy
themes.line: Love your neighbor as yourself, the law that gives freedom, care for orphans and widows, and mercy that triumphs over judgment.

themes.name: Desire, temptation and sin
themes.line: Temptation that comes from our own desires and not from God, and quarrels that come from passions at war within.

themes.name: Asking and praying
themes.line: Asking in faith, asking with wrong motives, and the prayer of faith for the suffering, the sick and the sinner.

themes.name: Humility and drawing near to God
themes.line: God opposes the proud and gives grace to the humble: submit, draw near, grieve over sin, and confess it to one another.

themes.name: The world and tomorrow
themes.line: Friendship with the world, the rich who fade in their pursuits, and boasting about tomorrow when life is a mist.

themes.name: God the giver
themes.line: The unchanging Father who gives every good gift and new birth, tempts no one, gives grace to the humble, and is full of compassion and mercy.

themes.name: The Lord's coming and his judgment
themes.line: The crown of life, judgment without mercy for the merciless, the Judge at the door, and patience until the Lord comes.

themes.name: One another
themes.line: No favoritism, care for a brother or sister in need, no slander or complaining, confession and prayer for each other, and bringing back the one who wanders.
